summary: The diff adds a TanStack Router-based multi-page marketing frontend skeleton (layout/header/footer, marketing sections/components, resources seed data, SEO helper, scroll-reveal hook) and a Motoko backend with contact submission storage and admin-gated read APIs. However, several BuildRequest acceptance criteria are not evidenced in the diff, notably stable persistence/migration for contact submissions, required backend endpoint names, full Resources/Contact page implementations/validation, per-route SEO usage, and inclusion of the required generated image assets.

missing_requirements.requirement: Resources listing + detail pages with consistent templates (title, summary, cover image, body content, author/date, related items), at least 6 seed resources, and routes that work with refresh.
missing_requirements.reason: Routes are defined, and seed data exists, but the diff does not include the actual ResourcesListPage/ResourceDetailPage implementations nor any evidence that direct navigation/refresh is configured to work. Also only 2 resources are visible in the truncated seed file, so 6+ cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Contact page form with client-side validation (required fields + email format), success/error states, backend persistence in stable state across upgrades, and backend endpoints createSubmission + listSubmissions (list not exposed in UI).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend endpoints are named saveContact/getAllContacts/getContact rather than createSubmission/listSubmissions; backend uses non-stable in-memory vars/Map with no stable storage or migration evidence. No ContactPage code is shown to confirm validation and UI success/error states.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each primary page sets a unique title and meta description; OpenGraph tags present referencing generated OG image; accessible semantics and alt text.
missing_requirements.reason: A Seo component exists that sets document title and meta/OG tags, but there is no evidence it is used on each primary route/page. Alt text is present for at least one image, but not verifiable site-wide from the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate and include the required image assets (hero illustration, partner logos strip, feature icons set, testimonial headshots, OpenGraph image) as newly generated visuals.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend references some generated asset paths, but the diff summary does not show the actual image files being added, so their presence cannot be confirmed.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin authorization system and secret-token initialization for access control around contact submission reads.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest requires a read API not exposed in UI, but does not request an admin role system, secret token initialization, or authorization mixins. The diff adds AccessControl/MixinAuthorization and a URL secret parameter flow.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication provider/hooks added even though authentication is not required for this request.
hallucinated_features.reason: The request states Internet Identity is allowed if authentication is later needed, but does not require adding an auth system now; the diff adds an InternetIdentityProvider/hook integration and uses it in actor creation.
